purpose.domain_detail: Japanese Medical Association standard receipt (reimbursement claim) software - inpatient/hospitalization billing confirmation screen (入院業務 請求確認画面)
purpose.summary: ORCGI04 is a screen program within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system handling the inpatient billing confirmation screen (I04 window). It processes screen navigation, entry validation, and data management for hospitalization billing records including patient information, insurance combinations, payment masters, and medical act records. It coordinates multiple subprograms via CALL and manages SPA (scratchpad area) state across screen transitions.

notable_features: 58 COPY statements referencing JMA-specific copybooks (CPPTINF, CPSYUNOU, CPJYURRK, etc.)
MCP (Message Control Program) event-driven screen handling pattern
SPA (Scratchpad Area) pattern for state management across screens
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT for event dispatch
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP database access layer
OCCURS tables for medical act and reception history records
149 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
verdict.notes: Source comments are encoded in Japanese EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake. The program is part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. The 'online-cics' program_type is used loosely - this is actually an MCP (Message Control Program) event-driven online screen program, not CICS, but the pattern is analogous.
